diagnostics.message: Type Error: функция должна возвращать объявленный тип

deviation.rationale: Odin reports 'Type Error: функция должна возвращать <ожидаемый>, но последнее выражение имеет тип <фактический>' (names both types); Zig's checkFunction (zig/core/type_checker.zig) reports only the generic message above, with no type-name formatter available in that file yet (runner.zig's formatTypeName is not reachable from type_checker.zig's own diagnostic-reporting call site). Real, tracked quality gap (worse error message, not a wrong-vs-right correctness bug — both correctly reject the program) — NOT fixed in T053 (out of scope: 'record baselines', not 'improve diagnostics'). Follow-up: add a type-name formatter usable from type_checker.zig and include actual/expected types in this message, matching Odin's.

Odin's CLI renders this same numeric result (mathematically identical, 12499997500000) as '1.24999975e+13' — Odin's fmt.tprintf("%v", f64) switches to scientific notation above ~15 significant digits (same underlying quirk documented for строки.из_числа elsewhere in this project). Zig's renderValue (zig/core/runner.zig) uses Zig's own '{d}' formatter, which does not have this quirk. Expected value above is Zig's (and the mathematically canonical) form — Odin is being retired (specs/010-zig-migration T058/T059), not worth replicating its formatting quirk in Zig.

This case is Zig-only, not cross-checked against Odin: Zig's resolver.zig makes native builtin modules (фс/ос/сеть/бд/...) ambient/always-in-scope with no импорт required or even accepted through the real module-graph path, while Odin requires an explicit `импорт <модуль>` for the same modules (confirmed: core/resolver.odin has no unconditional builtin-module installer; every native-builtin e2e test in core/e2e_*.odin imports explicitly). This means no single fixture source can run on both toolchains' real CLIs as-is — see T053's progress-report.md entry for the full investigation. Not fixed here: this is a real, foundational, pre-existing simplification from earlier in the migration, not a regression, and Odin is being retired (T058/T059) rather than made to match.

This tier exercises the SEPARATE MIR->WASM AOT pipeline (panos build --target=wasm, T043/T048), not the bytecode VM the `runtime` tier above uses — same source, same result, but a genuinely different execution path (no Odin equivalent exists to compare against: Odin never built a MIR-based AOT backend for this migration, see docs/src/architecture/toolchain-and-testing.md's MIR/WASM section). `stdout` here is the raw `wasmtime run --invoke старт` process output (includes wasmtime's own trailing newline), not the bytecode VM CLI's rendered value — the two tiers are not byte-for-byte comparable outcomes, only value-equal.
